context_notes: All phases 27-32 complete. Session focused on ADSR polish (always-on, knob scaling, reference line) and sampler UX (marker push, loop scrub, minimum gap). ADSR knob scaling was the hardest issue — PS1 shift register has exponential time relationship, initial naive mapping put all musical range in last 5% of knob. Power curve (knob^0.55) solved it. The ADPCM decoded amplitude is lower than source PCM (expected 4-bit codec behavior) but the ADSR engine IS shaping correctly — confirmed via diagnostic logging.
